summary_en: Policy to reduce strategic shareholdings to less than 10% of consolidated net assets by FY3/31. Proceeds to be deployed to business growth investment and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Policy for Reduction of Strategic Shareholdings
translation_en_brief: On 24 July 2026, Nihon Dengi announced a policy to reduce its strategic shareholdings to less than 10% of consolidated net assets by the end of FY3/31 (31 March 2031). The company stated that it conducts annual board-level reviews of all strategic holdings, assessing transaction history, maintenance of business relationships, financial benefits and risks. The announced reduction targets improvement in capital efficiency and sustained long-term value creation. Proceeds from the unwinding are to be deployed to business growth investment and enhancement of shareholder returns. The company intends to conduct transparent dialogue with investee companies to support understanding of the policy.
